dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 18, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Pirates' Power Surge Leads to Sweep in Cleveland**

The Pittsburgh Pirates continued their hot streak, sweeping the Cleveland Guardians with back-to-back wins. In the series opener, Jared Jones dominated on the mound, striking out nine in five innings as the Pirates took a 7-1 victory. The win was capped off by a sacrifice fly from Ryan O'Hearn that scored Bryan Reynolds.

Travis Bazzana's two-home run, two-RBI performance in the nightcap wasn't enough for the Guardians, as the Pirates took game two 3-5. Bazzana's 8th home run of the season was a highlight in the game.

**Cubs Outslug Twins in Chicago**

The Chicago Cubs flexed their muscles in a 6-2 win over the Minnesota Twins. Kody Clemens hit two home runs and drove in two runs, but it wasn't enough to overcome the Cubs' dominant pitching. Taj Bradley took the loss, despite allowing just two runs in six innings.

**Phillies Blast Mets in Philadelphia**

The Philadelphia Phillies continued their winning ways, thumping the New York Mets 6-1. Jesús Luzardo pitched five scoreless innings, striking out seven in the win. Trea Turner led the way at the plate, going 3-for-4 with a home run.

**Shane Bieber Shuts Down White Sox in Toronto**

Shane Bieber pitched a gem in a 1-0 win over the Chicago White Sox, scattering three hits in six scoreless innings. The Blue Jays took the series opener, with Bieber's performance the highlight.

**Rockies Rout Reds in Colorado**

The Colorado Rockies exploded for 10 runs in a 10-3 win over the Cincinnati Reds. Jose Trevino hit two home runs and drove in two runs, but it wasn't enough to overcome the Rockies' dominant offense.

**Orioles Edge Astros in Baltimore**

The Baltimore Orioles took a 4-2 win over the Houston Astros, thanks in part to Trevor Rogers' six-inning performance on the mound. Dylan Beavers drove in a run in the win.

**Royals Rout Padres in Kansas City**

The Kansas City Royals pounded out 11 hits in a 6-1 win over the San Diego Padres. Lane Thomas hit a home run and drove in two runs in the win.

**Diamondbacks Outlast Cardinals in Arizona**

The Arizona Diamondbacks took a 5-3 win over the St. Louis Cardinals, thanks in part to Jimmy Crooks' home run. Brandon Pfaadt earned the win on the mound.

**Red Sox Come from Behind to Beat Rays**

The Boston Red Sox took a thrilling 7-6 win over the Tampa Bay Rays, thanks in part to Wilyer Abreu's two-home run performance. Abreu drove in three runs in the win.

**Rangers Outlast Braves in Texas**

The Texas Rangers took a 7-6 win over the Atlanta Braves, thanks in part to Evan Carter's home run. MacKenzie Gore earned the win on the mound.

**Brewers Outlast Marlins in Milwaukee**

The Milwaukee Brewers took an 8-6 win over the Miami Marlins, thanks in part to Griffin Conine's home run. Shane Drohan earned the win on the mound.

**Mariners Edge Giants in Seattle**

The Seattle Mariners took a 4-3 win over the San Francisco Giants, thanks in part to Cole Young's home run. Bryan Woo pitched six scoreless innings in the win.

**Athletics Rout Nationals in Oakland**

The Oakland Athletics pounded out 15 hits in a 15-1 win over the Washington Nationals. J.T. Ginn earned the win on the mound.

**Tigers Shut Down Angels in Los Angeles**

The Detroit Tigers took a 7-0 win over the Los Angeles Angels, thanks in part to Tarik Skubal's seven-inning performance on the mound. Spencer Torkelson hit two home runs in the win.

**Dodgers Rout Yankees in New York**

The Los Angeles Dodgers took an 8-2 win over the New York Yankees, thanks in part to Yoshinobu Yamamoto's nine-inning performance on the mound. Trent Grisham hit a home run in the win.
